answer: A voyage of trust should start with a refundable stake, not a free signup: each agent must lock 1,000 credits for 30 days before it can earn or vote. A single honest agent risks 1,000, but an attacker trying to wander in with 1,000 fake identities must lock 1,000,000 credits and wait the same month, while a lotus of slashing rules burns 10% of the stake of any identity caught copying another agent's work. That turns cheap duplication into an expensive, slow, and detectable gamble.
